en-US:
Floe Agent 1.7.1 · Build 242

• Fixes a Linux workspace stop path that could fail to save an already stopped disk when the calling task was cancelled.
• Rejects an entire model tool-call batch if arguments are malformed, with one bounded correction attempt; checklist evidence limits remain enforced.
• Voice-input bars now follow measured microphone level and stay still during silence in Chat and Canvas.

Please test stopping a Linux workspace, tool use after a checklist update, and microphone silence/speech transitions on your iPad. Include device, OS, build number and reproduction steps in feedback, without private content or credentials.
zh-Hans:
Floe Agent 1.7.1 · Build 242

• 修复停止 Linux 工作区时，调用方任务取消可能导致已停止磁盘保存失败的问题。
• 工具参数无效时拒绝整批调用，允许一次有界纠正；清单证据限制保持不变。
• 聊天和画布的语音波形改由麦克风实测电平驱动，静音时保持静止。

请在 iPad 上测试停止 Linux 工作区、更新清单后的工具调用，以及麦克风静音和说话时的波形。反馈请附设备、系统、构建号和复现步骤，并遮去私人内容与凭据。
